Victorian rents by suburb

rentals.Rd

Median weekly rents and number of new lettings (new rental agreements) by suburb, property type, number of bedrooms and quarter. Cleaned from the raw CSV in data-raw/: aggregate rows ("All properties" and "Group Total") and rows with missing values were removed.

Usage

rentals

Format

A data frame with 86,368 rows and 8 columns:

year

Calendar year of the quarter (integer)

quarter

Calendar quarter, a factor with levels Q1 to Q4

property_type

Type of property, either "Flat" or "House"

no_of_bedroom

Number of bedrooms (integer)

new_lettings

Number of new rental agreements

median_rent

Median weekly rent for new lettings (dollars)

region

Region name

suburb

Suburb or suburb group name

Source

Victorian Department of Families, Fairness and Housing (DFFH) Rental Report, https://www.dffh.vic.gov.au/publications/rental-report, as compiled at https://publicdata.au/d/vic-rents-by-suburb/.
